name: cRZOStream::QueryInterface
notes: Differential: 39,794 cases over riids 1, 0xc51b11cb, and random values; AddRef counted via a recording slot 1. Returns bool; compared on al only (the original leaves eax upper bits undefined on bool returns). Mutants killed: skipped AddRef, dropped second IID. Not yet exercised in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZOStream::SetFloat32
notes: Differential: 20,000 cases with NaN payloads, denormals, signed zeros, random bits and both byte-order flags. Writes 4 native bytes whatever the flag (the original does not byte-swap floats). Mutant killed: byte-swapping when the flag is zero. Returns the raw write result unchanged. Not yet exercised in-game.

name: cRZOStream::SetFloat64
notes: Differential: 20,000 cases with NaN payloads, denormals, signed zeros, random bits and both byte-order flags. Writes 8 native bytes whatever the flag. Returns the raw write result unchanged. Not yet exercised in-game.

name: cRZOStream::SetGZSerializable
notes: Differential: 2,000 cases. Calls the serializable slot 3 with this stream as its one argument and returns its result. Mutant killed: passing null as the stream. The serializable interface is not identified yet, so the parameter is void*. Not yet exercised in-game.

name: cRZOStream::SetSint16
notes: Differential: 20,000 cases, edge values and random, both byte orders, all write results (0, 1, 0x100, 0xffffffff, 0x80000001). Byte order flag read as one byte at +8 (0x100 selects swapping). Mutant killed: inverted swap condition. Not yet exercised in-game.

name: cRZOStream::SetSint32
notes: Differential: 20,000 cases, both byte orders, flags with a zero low byte and nonzero upper bytes. Mutant killed: flag read as a dword (0x100 then wrongly stays native). Not yet exercised in-game.

name: cRZOStream::SetUint16
notes: Differential: 20,000 cases, both byte orders. Behaviour is identical to SetSint16 (the original zero-extends and then writes the same two bytes). Not yet exercised in-game.

name: cRZOStream::Construct
notes: Differential: 4,000 cases over byte-order arguments (low byte used) with junk in the whole object. Clears the count and owner, installs the base vtable, sets the flag. Mutants killed: owner not cleared, count set to 1, flag from order != 0. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZOStream::Destruct
notes: Differential: 2,000 cases with and without an owner; the owner's Release (slot 2) is logged together with whether the stream already carries the base vtable. Mutants killed: vtable not reset, AddRef slot instead of Release. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed). Three byte-identical copies exist in db/families.jsonl (other classes); only this RVA is hooked.

name: cRZOStream::DeletingDestructor
notes: Differential: 3,000 cases over flag sets; Destruct runs directly (not through the vtable), then a sized delete of 0x10 bytes when bit 0 is set. Returns this. Mutant killed: delete on any nonzero flag. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZOStream::Release
notes: Differential: 6,000 cases (counts 0..4, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff). Above 1: decrement and return the new count; otherwise slot 21 with 1, return 0. Slot 2 of both stream bases and 12 classes (shared_vf_1b5fc4). Shared by other classes' vtables, so it is verified but not hooked. Mutants killed: post-decrement, threshold off by one.

name: cRZOStream::SetByteOrder
notes: Differential: 4,000 cases. Stores the low byte of the argument at +8 and returns true. Slot 22 of both stream bases (23 classes share it). Shared by other classes' vtables, so it is verified but not hooked. Mutant killed: flag stored as order != 0.

name: cRZOStream::SetOwner
notes: Differential: 6,000 cases: tail jump into RZUnknownSlot::Assign on the +0xc slot (AddRef new, store, Release old); events and counts compared, returns the slot address. Slot 19 of both stream bases. Shared by other classes' vtables, so it is verified but not hooked. Mutant killed: assigning the old owner.

name: cRZOStream::SetSint8
notes: Differential: 4,000 cases (all low bytes, random upper bits, five raw-write results). Writes the argument's low byte through slot 17 and returns its result unchanged. Slots 4 and 5 (SetUint8 is the same code; also used by SetPackedUint32). Not hooked: db/functions.jsonl has no function start at this address (Ghidra size 0).

name: cRZOStream::SetSint64
notes: Differential: 20,000 cases, both byte orders, five write results. Swaps all eight bytes through 0x1b6734 unless the flag byte is nonzero. Mutants killed: inverted flag, value truncated to 32 bits. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZOStream::ByteSwap64
notes: Differential: 20,000 values (__stdcall, ret 8, result in edx:eax). Reverses the eight bytes. Used by SetSint64 and GetSint64. Mutant killed: swapping only the two halves. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZOStream::SetPackedUint32
notes: Differential: 20,000 values (edges, random bit lengths). 7 bits per byte, low group first, 0x80 continues, written through slot 5; the logged SetUint8 argument is the full dword (the last call keeps the value's upper 24 bits, as the original). Returns the last slot 5 result. Mutants killed: wrong continuation bit, last argument masked, zero special-cased differently. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZOStream::SetRZCharStr
notes: Differential: 10,000 strings up to 70,000 characters (length 0, one-byte to three-byte packed lengths). Inline strlen, SetPackedUint32, then the raw write unless empty (returns 1 for empty, else the write's low byte). Mutants killed: no length written, empty returns 0, length capped at 255. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZOStream::SetGZStr
notes: Differential: 10,000 strings (same lengths). Strlen (slot 7), SetPackedUint32, then ToChar (slot 5) and the raw write unless empty; the slot calls are logged in order. Mutants killed: length cut to a byte, empty returns 0, packed write skipped. Not hooked: db/functions.jsonl has no function start at this address.
